blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III on Friday expressed support for stronger protection for sugarcane farmers as the House brought discussions on the proposed TUBO Act directly to farmers and industry stakeholders during LegisHear in Victorias City, Negros Occidental. Speaking at the press briefing following the LegisHear townhall program, Dy said the consultation helps lawmakers understand the concerns of communities and strengthen proposed measures based on their experiences. “The proposed bill is a very important measure to protect our sugarcane farmers here in Negros,” Dy said, adding that the measure could also benefit farmers in other parts of the […]...
